description: PD Events API v2 event shape as accepted on POST /v2/enqueue (the PD-mirror route). Field requirements are grounded two ways: PagerDuty's own developer docs (request schema + 512 KB limit + 255-char dedup_key, see research/operating-without-vendor-apis.md §4) and the repo's _normalize_pd required set (routing_key, payload.summary, payload.source, payload.severity — missing any raises Unparseable). additionalProperties:true is the Tolerant Reader rule: L1/L2 ignore fields they do not understand; unknown fields never fail a delivery. Only event_action=trigger enters the normalize→triage path; acknowledge/resolve are relayed unchanged, untriaged (receiver.md §1.3).

dedup_key.description: ≤255 chars per PD docs. Absent ⇒ the alert gets a generated key at L2 (fingerprint fallback). Subsequent events with the same key apply to the open alert; after resolve, a new trigger opens a new alert.

event_action.description: trigger creates/extends alerts; acknowledge/resolve never create one (PD dedup semantics, §4). Relayed unchanged for non-trigger actions.

payload.description: PD payload object. component/group feed the L2 'service' derivation (component → group → source); class feeds 'check'; custom_details feed 'labels'.

component.description: PD payload.component → first choice for Alert.service.

group.description: PD payload.group → second choice for Alert.service.

images.description: PD images[]; images[].src required and HTTPS-only per PD docs.

severity.description: PD severity vocabulary. Passed through as Alert.severity_in; P1/P2 carve-out (DR-13) matches critical/high/p1/p2 case-insensitively at L3.

source.description: Hostname/FQDN preferred per PD docs → Alert.service fallback and labels.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601; PD auto-generates when absent. Informational at L2 — received_at is stamped by L1.

routing_key.description: 32-char integration key (ruleset keys begin with 'R'). Auth on the PD Events API is the routing key in the body — there is no auth header on PD's own API; Sentinel's ADR-005 HMAC rides alongside post-R-1.

title: PD Events API v2 event — ingress shape (contract C1)
